Hướng dẫn chuyển tiền vào tài khoản ngân.en: Guide to transfer money into bank accounts via post office
Hướng dẫn chuyển tiền vào tài khoản ngân.zh: 通过邮局将资金转入银行账户的指南

Họ tên người chuyển tiền.en: The name of the money transferer

Khách hàng từ xưa đến nay hẳn đã quen vớ.en: Customers have long since been accustomed to sending goods, correspondence through post office. However, depositing money into bank accounts through the post office is still quite new service, especially in rural areas. To meet the needs of many customers, the Vietnam Post Office opened this service to allow cash transfers to the bank account.
Khách hàng từ xưa đến nay hẳn đã quen vớ.zh: 长期以来,客户习惯于通过邮局发送货物和信件。 但是,通过邮局存入银行账户的资金仍然是相当新的服务,特别是在农村地区。 为了满足许多客户的需求,越南邮政局开设了这一服务,允许现金转入银行账户.

Kết nối với Vận Tải Lưu Lê qua các kênh.en: Connect with Media via Official Channels.
Kết nối với Vận Tải Lưu Lê qua các kênh.zh: 通过官方频道与媒体连接.

Nhìn chung, chuyển tiền qua bưu điện có.en: In general, deposits through the post office have a fairly simple, cheap cost and are currently chosen by many. The deep regions of the ATM tree may not be widely available or many do not know how to use them. The deposit through the post office is a suitable form that brings user utility. The cash has a direct transfer to the receiver account or to the local post office that the receiver lives in.
Nhìn chung, chuyển tiền qua bưu điện có.zh: 一般而言,通过邮局的存款成本相当简单、便宜,目前被许多人选中。 自动取款机树的深层区域可能无法广泛获得,或者许多区域不知道如何使用。 通过邮局的押金是一种合适的形式,可以带来用户的效用. 现金可直接转入收款人账户或收款人居住的当地邮局。

Nhìn chung, tiền chuyển qua bưu điện chắ.en: In general, the deposit was certainly not as fast as the bank. Maximum 3 days since the completion of the procedure, the amount of money you move will be in the recipient account. In the case of more than three days when the recipient's account number has not yet received the money you need immediately to the post office to re-check. So we recommend that you keep your receipts carefully moving money in case the transactions are malfunctioning during the transfer of money.
Nhìn chung, tiền chuyển qua bưu điện chắ.zh: 一般而言,存款肯定没有银行那么快。 程序完成后最多3天,您移动的资金金额将存入收款人账户。 超过3日,收款人账号尚未收到资金的,应当立即到邮局重新核对. 所以,我们建议你保持你的收据 仔细移动货币 以防交易 故障在转账。

Như bạn thấy, số tiền càng cao thì phí c.en: As you can see, the higher the amount of money, the greater the cost of the money, but generally the price of the money, remained relatively cheap. Also, you can move a lot of money in one transaction, and this is the advantage that bank ATM trees can't do.
Như bạn thấy, số tiền càng cao thì phí c.zh: 可见,钱币数额越高,钱币成本越高,但一般情况下,钱币价格仍然相对便宜. 另外,你可以在一次交易中移动大量资金,这也是银行自动取款机树无法做到的优势.

Nếu bạn đã sở hữu một tài khoản ngân hàn.en: If you already have a bank account, you probably already know how to transfer money into a basic account. In the most popular ways, moving money into the account via the post office is a fairly convenient way. In general, the money transfer method is not difficult if you refer to the information in this article.
Nếu bạn đã sở hữu một tài khoản ngân hàn.zh: 如果你已经有一个银行账户, 你可能已经知道如何将资金转入一个基本账户。 在最流行的方式中,通过邮局将资金转入账户是一个相当方便的方式. 一般来说,如果参考本条中的信息,汇款方法并不困难.

Phí chuyển tiền sẽ tùy thuộc vào số tiền.en: The money transfer fee will depend on the amount and area you send. Specifically as follows:
Phí chuyển tiền sẽ tùy thuộc vào số tiền.zh: 汇款费取决于您发送的金额和地区。 具体如下:

Phí chuyển tiền vào tài khoản ngân hàng.en: The fee of moving money into the bank account via the post office
Phí chuyển tiền vào tài khoản ngân hàng.zh: 通过邮局将资金转入银行账户的费用

Sau khi nhận được yêu cầu đồng ý chuyển.en: After receiving permission to transfer money from the customer, the post office staff completes the procedure and deposits from the post office into the receiver's body. However, depending on the circumstances where the money will move slowly differ.
Sau khi nhận được yêu cầu đồng ý chuyển.zh: 邮局工作人员在得到客户汇款许可后,完成手续,从邮局存入接收机构. 然而,取决于资金流动缓慢的情况。

Sau khi điền xong tờ thông tin, bạn ký t.en: After you have completed filling out the information, you sign down the form and transfer it to the postmaster. You need to be careful to reevaluate the information again, especially the account numbers and the money needed to be transferred to ensure that you give up the right information.
Sau khi điền xong tờ thông tin, bạn ký t.zh: 填好填报信息后,在表格上签名,并转寄邮编. 您需要谨慎地重新评价信息,特别是账户号码和需要转移的资金,以确保您放弃正确的信息.

Số tiền chuyển khoảng từ 3.000.000 – 5.0.en: The amount of transfers from 3,000,000 – 5,000,000, the port fee in the province was 51.818, the fee for the city's transfer of 61.818, the fee to other regions of 73,818....

Số tiền chuyển từ 50.000 – 3.000.000 đồn.en: The amount of transfers from 50,000 – $3,000,000, the province's transfer fee was 17.272, the fee to the city of 20,000, the fee to the other regions was $21.818.
Số tiền chuyển từ 50.000 – 3.000.000 đồn.zh: 5万元—300万元的调剂费,全省调剂费为17.272元,市费为2万元,其他地区调剂费为21.818元.

Tiếp theo, nhân viên sẽ kiểm tra thông t.en: Next, the staff will check the information one last time and give you the receipt to transfer the money. You sign the customer section that agrees to transfer the money and the post will keep one copy. Note carefully stored receipts when the money had not been transferred to the recipient account successfully. When depositing money into the bank account via the post office, the information you write needs to be especially accurate, if the mail is wrong, is not responsible for paying the money back.
Tiếp theo, nhân viên sẽ kiểm tra thông t.zh: 接下来,工作人员将最后一次检查信息,并给你收据以转账. 你签了客户部门同意转账 邮局会保留一份 在资金没有成功转入收款人账户时,注意仔细储存收据。 在通过邮局将资金存入银行账户时,你所写的信息需要特别准确,如果邮件错误,则不负责还款.

Trong trường hợp bạn ghi sai số tài khoả.en: In the event that you miswritten the receiver's account number that the account does not exist, the amount of money you transfer will return to the post office. Postman will now contact you to pick up the money. However, in the case of the wrong amount of the recipient's account, which exists, it will be difficult to regain. Therefore, you need to double-check the information before signing the transfer.
Trong trường hợp bạn ghi sai số tài khoả.zh: 如果你把接收者的帐号写错了,如果该帐号不存在,你转帐的金额将返回邮局。 邮差会联系你拿钱 然而,如果收受人账户中存在错误金额,则将难以收回. 因此,在签收转帐前,您需要重复检查信息.

Vận Tải Lưu Lê đã thông báo Bộ Công Thươ.en: Liu Load announced the Ministry of Commerce

Với hình thức chuyển tiền vào tài khoản.en: With the form of depositing money into the bank account via post office, you can transfer money either as a person or as a business representative. In general, the safety of this form of transfer of money is no less than a direct transfer of money through the bank. This method for many years has been very active internationally received.
Với hình thức chuyển tiền vào tài khoản.zh: 通过邮局将资金存入银行账户的形式,可以作为个人或者作为企业代表转移资金. 一般来说,这种货币转移形式的安全性不亚于通过银行直接转移货币. 多年来,这种方法一直受到国际上非常积极的欢迎。
